source_title: Chelsea news: Fan views on Wesley Fofana - BBC
source_excerpt:
We asked for your views on Chelsea's Wesley Fofana and whether it is time for the defender to move on or if you believe he has a future at Stamford Bridge, after comments from Blues fan Savage Dan on BBC Sport.
Di: I completely agree with Savage Dan but who will be willing to pay for Fofana given his continual poor performances? Maybe the club has enough money to pay another club to take him off our hands.
Christopher: The coverage of Wes is harsh. We've lacked a leader since JT left. There are plenty of players who could, potentially, become a leader but they all seem too scared to show the sort of leadership skills JT possessed. If you're going to pick out Wes for the handball at Amfield, then what about Cole being needlessly sent off against Spurs? That cost us big time.
Daniel : Yes he should really pack and go, he's possibly one of the worst signings we've ever made. Almost five years worth nothing, hugely disappointing! We should have sold him earlier instead of Chalobah.
Pete: Fofana probably ranks right up there with one of our worst signings. Cannot think of a decent performance he has given since he joined.
David: I had such high hopes for Fofana. He looked great at Leicester. That said, he's been very disappointing at Chelsea. Maybe the injuries have taken their toll, but whatever it is, he needs to move to a slower paced, less physical league. Sooner rather than later. Maybe an Italian or French club would pay Â£30m for him?
